plugins.name: 书籍翻译与注音
plugins.description: 整本书翻译和注音。翻译使用应用中配置的模型服务（支持本机模型），注音使用内置或 g2pW 引擎，结果直接加入书库。
plugins.author: Libzora

en-US.name: Book Translation & Pinyin
en-US.description: Translate whole books or add pinyin. Translation uses the configured model service, including local models; pinyin uses the built-in or g2pW engine. Results are added to the library.
